title: Double Trouble
reason: Shyvana chains two assists in two seconds as her team trades takedowns on Ryze and Ahri — her most productive window of the entire game.

title: Assist, Then Instant Karma
reason: VDRJ helps Milio finish Ryze and is deleted by Jinx literally one second later, perfectly summing up the game.

title: Tristana's Favorite Snack
reason: A third straight death to StonedInHell's Tristana cements the one-sided bounty relationship that would end with six kills on Shyvana.

title: Last Gasp Assist
reason: After a 4-minute deathstreak with nothing to show, Shyvana finally contributes to a Nautilus kill — and is immediately punished by Jinx again.

title: The One Kill
reason: At 0/13, VDRJ finally cashes in and takes down Ryze, the single solo kill of an otherwise brutal scoreline — and dies four seconds later.
